titulo: Word formation: compounds, prefixes and suffixes: Suffixes

aula.titulo: Word formation: compounds, prefixes and suffixes
aula.objetivo: Understand and build German words through compounding (Haustürschlüssel), verb prefixes (be-, ent-, er-, ver-, zer-; separable and inseparable) and suffixes (-ung, -heit, -keit, -schaft, -lich, -ig, -bar, -los), so you can work out the meaning of new words.

blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: SUFFIXES show the type of word and the gender. Many have English cousins. STEP 2: FEMININE nouns: «-UNG» (die Wohnung, die Meinung — often like English -ing), «-HEIT» and «-KEIT» (die Freiheit — freedom, die Kindheit — childhood, die Möglichkeit — possibility: like -hood, -dom, -ity), «-SCHAFT» (die Freundschaft — friendship: -ship!), «-TION» (die Information). STEP 3: nouns for PEOPLE: «-ER» (der Lehrer — teacher: -er!), «-IN» (die Lehrerin, the female form). STEP 4: DIMINUTIVES: «-CHEN» and «-LEIN» (always neuter): «das Mädchen», «das Büchlein». STEP 5: ADJECTIVES: «-LICH» (freundlich — friendly: -ly), «-IG» (ruhig — quiet: like -y), «-BAR» (lösbar — solvable: -able), «-LOS» (arbeitslos — jobless: -less!), «-VOLL» (sinnvoll — meaningful: -ful), «-ISCH» (typisch — typical: -ish/-ic), and the prefix «UN-» (negation, as in English): «unmöglich» (impossible). STEP 6: with these rules, you can guess the gender and meaning of new words.

tabela.exemplo: freundlich, ruhig, lösbar, arbeitslos, sinnvoll, typisch, unmöglich

blocos.titulo: Wortbildung im Deutschkurs / Word formation in German class
blocos.contexto: A teacher and two students play with words.

linhas.ru: — Heute sprechen wir über Wortbildung. Wer kennt ein langes Wort?
linhas.pt: — Today we're talking about word formation. Who knows a long word?
linhas.audio: Heute sprechen wir über Wortbildung. Wer kennt ein langes Wort?

linhas.ru: — Der Schlüssel, der zur Haustür gehört.
linhas.pt: — The key that belongs to the front door.
linhas.audio: Der Schlüssel, der zur Haustür gehört.

linhas.ru: — Und welchen Artikel hat das Wort?
linhas.pt: — And what article does the word have?
linhas.audio: Und welchen Artikel hat das Wort?

linhas.ru: — Den Artikel vom letzten Wort: „der Schlüssel", also „der Haustürschlüssel".
linhas.pt: — The article of the last word: «der Schlüssel», so «der Haustürschlüssel».
linhas.audio: Den Artikel vom letzten Wort: „der Schlüssel", also „der Haustürschlüssel".

linhas.ru: — Sehr gut! Und das Substantiv zu „möglich"?
linhas.pt: — Very good! And the noun from «möglich»?
linhas.audio: Sehr gut! Und das Substantiv zu „möglich"?

itens.ru: Ich rufe wegen der Wohnungsanzeige an.
itens.audio: Ich rufe wegen der Wohnungsanzeige an.

itens.pt: I'm buying a can of tomatoes.

itens.ru: Mein Neffe geht auf das Gymnasium.
itens.pt: My nephew goes to the Gymnasium (academic high school).
itens.audio: Mein Neffe geht auf das Gymnasium.

itens.enunciado: What's the article of Handtasche (Hand + Tasche)? (der, die, das)
What's the article of Kinderzimmer? (der, die, das)
What's the article of Haustür? (der, die, das)
What does Gift mean? (gift, poison)
What does bekommen mean? (to get/receive, to become)
Which word means "skirt", the piece of clothing?
itens.explicacao: «Rock» means skirt here: der Rock. «Rente» means pension — and careful, English "rent" is «die Miete».

itens.enunciado: Which suffix means "without", like English -less?
itens.explicacao: The suffix «-los» can show that something is missing, as in «arbeitslos» (jobless). «-bar» usually expresses possibility, like English -able.

Form the word asked for: wohnen → die ___ (-ung)
itens.explicacao: From «wohnen» comes the noun «Wohnung». The stem wohn- takes -ung, and the noun is capitalized.

itens.enunciado: Form the word asked for: verkaufen → the man who sells: der ___ (-er); the woman: die Verkäuferin
itens.explicacao: The man who sells is «der Verkäufer». You add -er and change au to äu; the prefix ver- stays.

itens.enunciado: Form the word asked for: verkaufen → the man who sells: der Verkäufer (-er); the woman: die ___
itens.explicacao: The feminine of «Verkäufer» is «Verkäuferin», with -in. The article «die» is already given.

itens.enunciado: Form the word asked for: krank → die ___ (-heit)
itens.explicacao: «Krank» takes the suffix -heit and forms the feminine noun «Krankheit» (illness, sickness). It's capitalized.

itens.enunciado: Form the word asked for: die Arbeit → "without work": ___ (-los)
itens.explicacao: «Arbeitslos» is made of «Arbeit», the linking -s- and the suffix -los (like English job-less). As an adjective, it's lowercase.

itens.enunciado: Complete with the verb that means "to get, to receive", not "to become": Ich ___ zu Weihnachten einen Pullover.
itens.explicacao: «Bekommen» means to get or receive: Ich bekomme zu Weihnachten einen Pullover (I'm getting a sweater for Christmas). It does NOT mean "become" — that's «werden».

itens.enunciado: Choose the word for "a can of tomatoes": Ich kaufe eine ___ Tomaten.
itens.explicacao: «Eine Dose Tomaten» means a can of tomatoes. «Dosis» means a dose, for example of medicine — not the container.

itens.enunciado: The sign means: Careful! This is poison. Complete: Vorsicht! Das ist ___!
itens.explicacao: «Gift» means poison. «Geschenk» means gift, present — a classic false friend for English speakers.
